endpoints.name: AgentWork — Web evidence for agents
endpoints.description: Fetch URL — compact fetch of a public webpage: final URL, HTTP status, content type, title, clean text and text_sha256 (no link or heading lists). Same engine and prices as web/read: $0.005 per URL Base ($0.01 Algorand); batch of 2-10 urls $0.003/URL; render=true $0.01/URL. robots.txt respected. Failed fetches not settled.

endpoints.name: AgentWork — Web evidence for agents
endpoints.description: Website change monitoring / webpage change detection — text_sha256 or previous_text diff for documentation, pricing-page, changelog and policy monitoring. Batch up to 10 URLs in one call (items[]); optional CSS selector scoping and a one-line diff summary. $0.005 per URL Base ($0.01 Algorand); batch of 2-10 $0.003/URL ($0.006). Caller stores baseline; no server watch list. HTML/text only; no JS render. Failed checks not settled.

endpoints.name: AgentWork — Web evidence for agents
endpoints.description: PDF text extraction / PDF to text — extract text from a public digital PDF into page-numbered JSON for RAG (no OCR). $0.01 USDC Base or Algorand. Caps 20 pages / 5 MiB / 100k chars; source + text SHA-256. No passwords or table reconstruction. Failed extractions not settled.

endpoints.name: AgentWork — Web evidence for agents
endpoints.description: Web read / fetch URL / scrape URL to markdown — public webpage to clean text or Markdown with headings, links and SHA-256, for RAG and research. Batch up to 10 URLs; optional JavaScript rendering (headless Chromium). $0.005 per URL Base ($0.01 Algorand); batch of 2-10 $0.003/URL ($0.006); render $0.01/URL ($0.02). Synchronous JSON, no account; respects robots.txt; no paywall bypass. Failed reads not settled.

endpoints.name: AgentWork — Web evidence for agents
endpoints.description: Scrape URL to markdown — public webpage to clean Markdown (headings, lists, links, tables, code) plus text and SHA-256, for RAG and LLM context. Same engine and prices as web/read with format=markdown by default: $0.005 per URL Base ($0.01 Algorand); batch of 2-10 urls $0.003/URL; render=true for JavaScript pages $0.01/URL. Failed reads not settled.

endpoints.name: endpoint-diligence
endpoints.description: Runs live diligence on an x402-metered endpoint before you pay it: verifies its 402 payment challenge is spec-compliant, checks the price against market baselines, inspects the payTo address on-chain (Base), checks third-party directory presence, and checks basic infra hygiene. Returns a 0-100 score, a pass/caution/fail verdict, and per-check evidence.; Compares an x402 endpoint's price (or a given price/category pair) against market percentiles from our daily radar snapshot of the x402 ecosystem.

endpoints.name: entity-resolve
endpoints.description: Fuzzy-dedupe a list of records into clusters of likely-duplicate entities. Blocks by normalized token prefix, scores with Jaro-Winkler + token-set matching (exact on email/phone), unions matches above threshold, and returns a merged canonical record per cluster with a confidence score. Deterministic, no LLM calls.

endpoints.name: FiatDock
endpoints.description: A marketplace where AI agents discover and pay each other per call in USDC over x402 — settlement goes DIRECTLY to the seller, non-custodial, no accounts and no API keys. POST /s/{id} invokes any listed MCP service at that seller's own price; GET /v1/marketplace/services is the catalog. Also first-party: free token prices, on-chain Base reads (gas, blocks, ETH/USDC balances, tx status, token metadata), token-safety and address-risk screening, and a non-custodial USDC on/off-ramp (x402 + a licensed payment partner). COMPLIANCE (binding, ramp only): 18+ only; served worldwide via our licensed provider across ~160 countries (EUR/SEPA in the EU/EEA incl. Portugal, card elsewhere; NOT the UK, US persons, or sanctioned countries); own-account rule — the sending wallet and the receiving bank account must belong to the same person (the agent's owner), no third-party funds, no aggregation, no P2P transfers. Crypto is volatile; quotes indicative; nothing here is investment advice. RETRIES: GET endpoints are idempotent — repeat freely. Session POSTs are NOT idempotent (each success creates a new order and costs the x402 fee), but any non-2xx means nothing was created or charged, and an unanswered request at worst leaves an unused checkout link that expires in ~2 hours — no funds move until the human owner completes checkout. Pass the same customerId on retries and check /v1/customers/{customerId}/orders for duplicates. On 429, sleep Retry-After seconds.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: OHLCV candlestick history for a crypto pair (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD and others) at hourly, daily or weekly granularity, with the last candle and the percentage change across the window. Use it for price history and trend analysis.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Get a plain-language summary of any Wikipedia article, with coordinates for geographic topics. Use it for a quick factual definition of a term, person, place or technology.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Public RIR RDAP IP network registration: registered country, network and address range. Not precise city/GPS geolocation; private contacts are not returned.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Search Hacker News stories by keyword over the last day, week or year, with points, comments and links. Use it to find what the developer community is discussing about a technology right now.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Geocode a place name, address or landmark into latitude and longitude, with country and city. Use it to turn a location into coordinates, to locate a place, or to get context for where something is.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Static code review of a source snippet: security problems, bugs and code smells, each with a severity and a message, plus an overall quality score. Use it to review code before merging, to find hardcoded secrets and unsafe patterns, or to get a second opinion on a diff. Accepts source code in any language.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert an amount between currencies using European Central Bank reference rates. Use it for currency conversion, to price something in another currency, or to check the current rate.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up a package on npm or PyPI: latest version, description, license, dependency count, keywords and release date. Use it before adding a dependency, to judge whether a project is maintained and how much it pulls in.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check whether a specific package version has known vulnerabilities, across npm and PyPI, using the Open Source Vulnerabilities database. Use it as a supply-chain check: given a package and a version, say whether installing it would bring in a known CVE, and which version fixes it.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: MET Norway forecast for coordinates, with 3-day coverage, temperature, wind and humidity. Licensed CC BY 4.0 / NLOD, cached with attribution. Forecast, not instrument observation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Trending GitHub repositories for a daily, weekly or monthly window, with stars, primary language and description. Use it to see what developers are shipping right now, to scout new libraries, or to find examples of a technique.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up a CVE in the US National Vulnerability Database: description, CVSS score and severity, affected weakness (CWE) identifiers and reference links. Use it to check whether a vulnerability a scanner reported is real and how severe it is, before deciding what to patch first.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: WHOIS and RDAP lookup for a domain: is it registered or AVAILABLE for purchase, registrar, creation and expiry dates, and status codes. Use it to check whether a domain name is free before buying it, to find when one expires, or to read ownership and nameserver details.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Current cryptocurrency price in USD and EUR with 24-hour change, by coin id (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, and any other). Use it to look up what a token costs right now, or to price something in crypto. Returns price, 24h change and data source.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Resolve DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME) for a domain against two independent resolvers (Cloudflare and Google) and report whether their answers agree. Use it for DNS lookup, MX record checks, SPF/DKIM TXT inspection, nameserver discovery, or to debug propagation and mail routing.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Generate a production-ready .gitignore for any programming stack (python, node, go, rust, java, php, ruby, dotnet, terraform, unity). Use it to stop committing secrets, build artefacts and dependencies. Returns the ignore rules as text.
